name: binary-logistic-update
expect: one update increases probability for the positive fixture
explain: Calculate a real gradient step for one binary logistic example. One update is not a fitted or evaluated classifier.
steps: Compute the sigmoid prediction and cross-entropy gradient. || Move opposite the gradient and inspect the changed prediction.

name: naive-bayes-smoothing
expect: unseen token has finite smoothed likelihood
explain: Show how smoothing avoids zero likelihood for an unseen vocabulary term. This is one likelihood calculation, not a full text benchmark.
steps: Add explicit smoothing counts. || Verify finite likelihoods and normalization for the declared vocabulary.

name: tree-impurity-split
expect: pure child split reduces Gini impurity by 0.5
explain: Compute one split objective. Actual tree ensembles are fitted in the downloadable lab.
steps: Compute parent impurity. || Compare weighted child impurity and its reduction.

name: neighbor-vote-and-margin
expect: local vote selects A; margin penalty is not a probability
explain: Distinguish a neighbor voting rule from an SVM margin penalty on numeric fixtures. Real estimators are compared in the lab.
steps: Inspect nearest labeled examples. || Calculate hinge loss without interpreting it as a calibrated probability.

name: group-split-invariant
expect: different row IDs can still leak the same source group
explain: Detect a correlated source across partitions. This does not establish future-population representativeness.
steps: Compare source groups rather than only row IDs. || Reject the overlapping split and accept the disjoint fixture.

name: minority-class-metrics
expect: accuracy: 0.99; minority recall: 0.0
explain: Calculate two metrics with explicit denominators on an imbalanced fixture.
steps: Compute overall correctness. || Separately measure recovery of the minority class.

name: classification-threshold-policy
expect: score and ambiguity policy determine acceptance; unknown detection still needs evaluation
explain: Exercise a score-and-margin policy. Its values are synthetic and neither calibrated probabilities nor a complete novelty detector.
steps: Apply an explicit operating threshold. || Reject a low-margin case even when its top score is high.

name: multilabel-hierarchy-contract
expect: two valid intents retained; required parent added
explain: Use synthetic independent scores to preserve two intents and add their declared parent. This is decoding, not model fitting.
steps: Keep every label meeting the declared policy. || Enforce the taxonomy parent relationship.

name: embedding-prototype-rule
expect: synthetic nearest prototype: A; real embeddings require the optional lab
explain: Explain the prototype rule on declared vectors. The optional text lab produces and evaluates actual pinned-model embeddings.
steps: Normalize valid numeric vectors. || Compare directions and retain the winning prototype under the declared rule.

name: representation-head-compatibility
expect: same dimension rejected when model identity differs
explain: Validate an explicit representation manifest. It does not perform a neural model call.
steps: Compare model identity as well as shape. || Accept only the declared compatible preprocessing contract.

name: contrastive-pair-contract
expect: conflicting pair supervision detected before fitting
explain: Reject a direct contradictory pair. The comment identifies transitive consistency as an extension; no unconstrained estimator is claimed to enforce constraints.
steps: Record reviewed positive and negative pair identities. || Detect their direct contradiction before fitting.

name: label-output-evidence-contract
expect: allowed shape accepted; unsupported label and evidence rejected
explain: Check allowed labels and evidence identifiers for synthetic responses. Schema and reference validity do not establish the semantic correctness of the label or theme.
steps: Parse and validate taxonomy membership. || Reject invented evidence references as a separate contract failure.

name: weak-label-provenance
expect: teacher proposal retained as weak evidence; reviewed target preserved
explain: Exercise one narrow label-authority rule. Review and dataset splitting remain separate application responsibilities.
steps: Mark the source of a proposed label. || Preserve the independently reviewed target instead of silently relabeling it.

name: equal-budget-comparison-contract
expect: matched evaluation and timing contracts required before comparison
explain: Check compatibility of benchmark descriptions, not measured system performance.
steps: Compare the evaluation and timing scopes. || Correct a mismatched scope before interpreting results.

name: lloyd-numeric-partition
expect: Lloyd centers: [0.5, 9.5]; partition verified
explain: Run actual assignment and mean updates on declared numeric data. Neural embeddings and large-scale fitting are separate lab modes.
steps: Assign each numeric point to its nearest current center. || Update means until the tiny fixture converges and check its partition.

name: cosine-euclidean-geometry
expect: unit-vector distance relation verified; algorithm updates still matter
explain: Verify the unit-vector identity without claiming ordinary mean updates implement spherical K-means.
steps: Compute the dot product of unit vectors. || Compare it to their squared Euclidean distance.

name: cluster-identity-permutation
expect: different cluster IDs; identical membership relation
explain: Demonstrate permutation invariance of a partition relation. Actual adjusted Rand index is computed by the optional lab.
steps: Ignore arbitrary integer names. || Compare whether each pair shares a group.

name: silhouette-validity
expect: silhouette positive for the fixture; a single group would be undefined
explain: Calculate a valid tiny silhouette from exact distances. This does not prove semantic usefulness or a true cluster count.
steps: Compute within- and nearest-other-group distances. || Check the score and its valid-partition preconditions.

name: dbscan-core-neighborhood
expect: core: {1}; border: {0, 2}; noise: {3}
explain: Identify core, border and noise points under an explicit self-counting convention. The full clustering estimator is executed in the lab.
steps: Build exact radius neighborhoods. || Distinguish core support, border attachment and isolated noise.

name: linkage-distance-counterexample
expect: single linkage: 1.0; complete linkage: 10.0
explain: Compute two linkage definitions on declared numeric groups. Actual agglomerative fitting is supplied by the lab.
steps: List pairwise cross-group distances. || Compare the nearest-pair and farthest-pair merge criteria.

name: mixture-responsibility-step
expect: responsibilities: [0.8, 0.2]; conditional on the declared mixture
explain: Perform one responsibility normalization. Likelihoods are synthetic, not a fitted Gaussian density or a human category posterior.
steps: Multiply component priors by declared likelihoods. || Normalize under that mixture and preserve its limited interpretation.

name: cluster-estimator-api
expect: mini-batch, density hierarchy, spectral and PCA fits executed
explain: Execute actual estimators and validate basic output shape. Inspect the full lab for partitions, audit metrics and known limitations rather than interpreting shape checks as quality proof.
steps: Fit three distinct clustering families on a local numeric fixture. || Validate the separately fitted PCA output without claiming UMAP execution.
limit: Complete CPU example. Install numpy==2.0.2 and scikit-learn==1.9.1 in a virtual environment, then run the downloaded file. It uses local numeric fixtures and does not call a model provider.
